title: An integral morphism has exact pushforward on etale sheaves and vanishing higher direct images
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for an integral, in particular finite, morphism of algebraic spaces the pushforward on etale sheaves is exact and all higher direct images vanish (statement lines 495-501). The proof reduces to the case of schemes by computing the higher direct images along an etale cover of the target and invoking representability of integral morphisms, and then applies the corresponding statement for integral morphisms of schemes in etale cohomology. The reduction to schemes is the substance, so the claim is H2.
